name: M3_OIS100MI_SndBatchLine
description: Create batch order lines in the batch order files. Behaves like **AddBatchLine**: adds order lines to an existing batch order using the same field set, but normal customer‑order validations are largely skipped. Data is written mostly "as is" and is fully validated only when the batch order is confirmed into a firm customer order. Catch weight input is allowed even for negative ordered quantities and for direct orders (codes 3 and 4). Planning and delivery fields can be used to control dates and to override availability checks.
